items.text: Early-week (Tue) note; first official practice reports come Wednesday. Tennessee: WR Carnell Tate (shoulder) missed Week 10, coach hopeful for this week; QUESTIONABLE - WR Wan'Dale Robinson (ankle), S Tony Adams (concussion). OUT - LB Anthony Hill Jr. IR - G Peter Skoronski. Cam Ward starts.

Early-week (Tue) note; first official practice reports come Wednesday. Dallas: G Tyler Booker (high ankle sprain, ~4 weeks) and CB DaRon Bland (high ankle sprain) out. OUT last week - TE Jake Ferguson, WR Jonathan Mingo, S Juanyeh Thomas, S P.J. Locke, LB Donovan Ezeiruaku. IR - S Jalen Thompson, RB Tyler Goodson. Dak Prescott starts.
